component.name: picosdk-c-examples
component.description: C/C++ example code for PicoScope oscilloscopes and PicoLog data loggers.

properties.name: cdx:note
properties.value: Hand-authored starter SBOM. Regenerate with a tool (e.g. syft or cdxgen) as part of release, and re-issue serialNumber and timestamp automatically. Component versions marked 'unknown' must be confirmed.

components.name: pbPlots
components.description: Portable C plotting library used for PNG output. Vendored as source: shared/pbPlots.c, shared/pbPlots.h, shared/supportLib.c, shared/supportLib.h.

properties.name: cdx:note
properties.value: Upstream does not publish a version string; pin to a specific upstream commit and record it here.

components.name: PicoSDK
components.description: Proprietary PicoSDK runtime driver libraries required to build and run the examples (e.g. libpsospa, libps6000a, libps5000a, libps4000a, libps3000a, libps2000a, libps2000, libpicohrdl, libpl1000, libplcm3, libusbdrdaq). Not distributed in this repository; installed separately from picotech.com/downloads.

properties.name: cdx:note
properties.value: Record the exact PicoSDK release version used for a given build/release.

components.name: C standard math library (libm)
components.description: System math library linked on Linux/macOS builds.
